name: test_session_invalid_after_logout
description:
After logout, directly navigating to /inventory.html should NOT
        display the inventory page (session must be invalidated).
descriptionHtml:
After logout, directly navigating to /inventory.html should NOT
    display the inventory page (session must be invalidated).

testStage.description:
After logout, directly navigating to /inventory.html should NOT
        display the inventory page (session must be invalidated).

steps.name: Logout, then attempt direct navigation to inventory.html
Assert user is NOT on the inventory page (redirected/blocked)

retries.statusDetails:
AssertionError: assert False
 +  where False = assert_true((not True or False), 'Direct access to inventory.html after logout should be blocked')
 +    where assert_true = <pages.inventory_page.InventoryPage object at 0x7fde0b2574d0>.assert_true
 +    and   True = is_inventory_page_displayed()
 +      where is_inventory_page_displayed = <pages.inventory_page.InventoryPage object at 0x7fde0b2574d0>.is_inventory_page_displayed
 +    and   False = is_error_displayed()
 +      where is_error_displayed = <pages.login_page.LoginPage object at 0x7fde0ae1c260>.is_error_displayed
